An equal opportunity, multi-certified industrial coatings and painting contractor is currently hiring industrial painters to perform interior and exterior painting of industrial projects,. Duties include prepping surfaces for painting and applying paint, assisting other skilled workers in performing their assigned duties, installing and disassembling access platforms and scaffolding.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Following safety instructions, rules, and regulations
  • Prepares surfaces using industrial materials and machinery
  • Abrasive blasting with high pressure hoses/nozzles and other tools
  • Performs a variety of routine, non-machine tasks, such as installing and removing containment systems/tarps, rigid containment, erecting scaffolding, fall protection systems, and safety barriers in line with “safe work procedure”
  • Painting using plural, conventional, and airless spray equipment, brushes, and rollers
  • Lifting, carrying, and holding building materials, tools, and supplies
  • Mixing, applying paints and solvents using hand and power tools
  • May use some machinery such as paint pumps, blast pots, recyclers, tele-handlers/forklifts, aerial boom lifts, scissor lifts, and other power tools / equipment
  • Work at heights
  • Work in tight and/or confined spaces
  • Install and/or dismantle ventilation systems
  • Will be transferred from task to task as the project progresses to completion
  • Cleaning tools, equipment, materials, and work areas
  • May be called on to clean down manufacturing & paint equipment with solvents and power washer

JOB QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:
Completion of formal apprenticeship program or admittance through labor union. Considerable attention required to prevent injury to self and others when working on ladders, scaffolds, and other elevated work areas.

  • Physically stand or walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl for long periods
  • Use arms and hands to reach for, handle, and manipulate objects
  • Lift, carry, push, and pull materials weighing 50 to 125 pounds
  • Climb up and down ladders, stair towers, and scaffolds
  • Have the visual and hearing capacity to perform work without harm to self or others
  • Must be able to pass requirements of pre-employment testing
  • Able to work productively in heat index exposure at or about 112 ̊ F
  • Must be able to work productively in cold weather
  • Attend work regularly to ensure acclimation to temperature extremes
  • Prompt and on time attendance
  • Don and perform work wearing air purifying and supplied air respirators and abrasive blast hoods
  • Using / wearing personal protective equipment (PPE) including but not limited to full body harness, personal flotation device, tyvek coveralls, safety glasses, hearing protection, etc.
  • Adhere to the no smoking policy
  • Reporting injuries and unsafe conditions or work practices to supervisors immediately
  • Work well with others
  • Being familiar with the Code of Safe Work Practices, “Job Safety and You.”
  • Actively participating in “toolbox” or “tailgate” safety meetings
  • Must have the mental capacity / skill to attain and retain certifications related to the coatings industry
  • Be committed to an alcohol and drug free workplace
  • Work away from primary residence for long periods of time
  • Perform other duties as assigned from time to time by the supervisor
  • Industrial painting experience preferred

title: Mechanic
description: POSITION SUMMARY: Reporting to the Lead Mechanic/ Shop Supervisor, the Mechanic is responsible for maintaining, diagnosing, repairing and operating diesel, hydraulic, electrical, and pneumatic…

POSITION SUMMARY:  Reporting to the Lead Mechanic/ Shop Supervisor, the Mechanic is responsible for maintaining, diagnosing, repairing and operating diesel, hydraulic, electrical, and pneumatic mechanical equipment and vehicles within the company fleet. Thomas Industrial Coatings is an equal opportunity employer.

TASKS:

  • Implement the safety program in accordance with company standards
  • Ensure a safe, orderly, and functional work environment is maintained
  • Conduct preventative maintenance, operation analysis, and repairs on diesel, pneumatic, hydraulic and general automotive systems
  • Diagnose mechanical and operational problems on all mechanical equipment
  • Complete work orders and assigned daily tasks, as well proper assigned documentation
  • Make necessary corrections and running adjustments, to equipment, to maintain maximum production and quality
  • Utilize and maintain diagnostic to test the functionality of equipment
  • Ensure quality standards are met during repairs and preventative maintenance of all mechanical equipment
  • Provide mechanical support in the field to diagnose, repair, and maintain equipment
  • Conduct preventive maintenance checks and inspections of mechanical equipment
  • Ensure reoccurring equipment malfunctions are detected and corrective actions are taken
  • Attend and complete any and all educational classes that are required by the company
  • Ensures equipment is compliant with all regulations and standards
  • Perform all duties of a Mechanic, as needed
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by supervisor

REQUIRED SKILLS and ABILITIES:    

  • Physical Ability- Physically stand or walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, and crawl for long periods, use arms and hands to reach for, handle, and manipulate objects, lift, carry, push, and pull materials weighing 50 to 100 pounds, climb up and down ladders and scaffolds; Able to work productively in a variety of weather conditions.
  • Mental Alertness- Able to focus on multiple tasks simultaneously and in an efficient manner
  • Active Listening- Gives full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interruption at inappropriate times
  • Speaking and Writing- Communicates effectively with clients and co-workers
  • Reading Comprehension – Understands written sentences and paragraphs in work related documents
  • Service Orientation - Ability to work in high production environment and respond quickly and effectively under pressure and deadlines
  • Critical Thinking – Uses logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solution, conclusions or approaches to problems
  • Near Vision – Is able to see details at close range (within a few feet of observer)
  • Speech Clarity and Recognition – Speaks clearly so others can understand, and can identify and understand the speech of another person
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), iPad/iPhone based applications, as well as proprietary software required
  • Travel – Occasional travel with week-long stays when needed
  • Working knowledge in diesel, pneumatic, hydraulic and general automotive repair
  • Knowledge and ability to work a Telehandler and forklift

SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hold and maintain a clean driving record
  • Ensure departmental staff follow proper safety protocol
  • Observe all safety rules established for your protection and guidance
  • Use safety equipment and devices provided or required
  • Work in a way that safeguards you and your fellow workers
  • Report any and all injuries to your immediate supervisor
  • Arrive rested, alert, and aware of what is going on around you
  • Be aware of recognizable hazards
  • Know the correct, safe procedures for your job
  • Comply with company drug and alcohol policies

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND LICENSURE:

  • Preferred: Associates degree from an accredited college or university preferred
  • Preferred: At least 2 years’ experience in diesel, pneumatic, hydraulic and general automotive repair preferred
  • Valid Driver’s License
  • Preferred: CDL
  • CPR, First Aid certification, OSHA 30, SSPC C-3 Worker Lead may be obtained prior to and/ or upon employment
